text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — execs just approved a one-time 8-hour PTO top-up for all full-time employees to use for mental health, caregiving, or recharge this spring. Expires in 90 days. :seedling:
Tom: Nice! Is that in addition to regular PTO or does it come out of accruals?
Aisha: It’s an extra credit — doesn't affect your normal accruals. Not cashable and can't be carried over. We’ll auto-apply it to your balance by EOD Monday. :calendar:
Priya: Does this apply to contractors / part-time folks?
Aisha: Short answer: no, it's for FT headcount on payroll. We’re evaluating future options for contractors — will share updates.
Tom: Cool. Any blackout windows (like product launch weeks) where we should avoid taking it?
Aisha: No mandatory blackout, but pls coordinate with your manager for critical launch days. If a team needs coverage exceptions, reach out and we'll help triage.
Priya: Related Q — any travel guidance tied to this? I'm planning a conference trip next month.
TravelBot: Automated reminder: company travel still requires pre-approval for international trips and any travel to high-risk regions. Submit the Travel Authorization form: https://intranet.redwood.com/forms/travel-auth
Maya: Quick checklist I promised to share re: safety + docs for international travel — copying below so folks can screenshot: 
```
- Upload passport copy to Travel Auth
- Add emergency contact in HR profile
- Confirm KMS access for devices if carrying company laptop
- Get pre-travel security briefing for high-risk regions
```
Sam: Thanks Maya — small ask: can People Ops add the top-up policy and travel checklist to the benefits page? Would help managers.
Aisha: Yes — uploaded now: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/wellness-topup and added a 2-min manager FAQ. Also sending a short code-of-conduct refresher: all staff should complete the 5-min micro-course this quarter. Not mandatory but strongly encouraged. :sparkles:
Tom: Awesome, thanks. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Aisha: You're welcome. If you have edge cases (FT transfer dates, LOA overlaps), DM me and we’ll sort it out.
Priya: One last item — will the top-up show as a separate line on payslips?
Aisha: It’s recorded in the time-off system and will appear on your internal time summary, not on payroll payslips.
Sam: returning to work after parental leave next week — will I get the top-up retroactively?
Aisha: If your return date is before the top-up expiry window, yes — we’ll credit it to your account. If not, DM for exceptions.
TravelBot: FYI — Travel Auth processing SLA is 48 hours for standard requests; expedited available for urgent conf requests.
Maya: linking training quickie for managers: https://intranet.redwood.com/learn/manager-wellness-brief
Aisha: Thanks everyone — closing thread. We'll post the official email to whole company at 10:00am PT. :email:
